BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to No. 11 The Court, Robswall a superb one-bedroom ground floor apartment nestled within one of Malahide's most sought-after coastal developments. Offering spacious light-filled accommodation and a private ground floor setting, this attractive home is an ideal choice for first-time buyers, downsizers or anyone seeking a quality property in a prime location.

The accommodation briefly comprises of an entrance hall with a large storage closet, bedroom with an abundance of fitted wardrobes, bathroom, open plan kitchen / dining / lounge and a patio. 

Set within the prestigious Robswall development residents benefit from beautifully maintained landscaped grounds and an unrivalled coastal setting. Just a pleasant stroll along the scenic coastline leads you to the vibrant heart of Malahide Village, renowned for its excellent selection of cafés, award-winning restaurants, stylish boutiques and welcoming pubs. Along with the stunning coastline, Malahide Castle, excellent transport links and every local amenity on your doorstep, No. 11 The Court presents an exceptional opportunity to enjoy an enviable coastal lifestyle
